fact: On 25 June 2024 the ANPDP's president José Manuel Macumbo Costa Alegre signed the Lisbon Declaration founding the Lusophone Data Protection Network, with ANPDP member Dyazemar Pinheiro attending, and signed the network's statutes on 20 March 2025.
title: Rede Lusófona de Proteção de Dados
publisher: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD), Portugal
